title: KL Rahul hits India’s fastest men’s World Cup hundred
summary: KL Rahul reached his century in 62 balls against the Netherlands in Bengaluru. He finished with 102 off 64 balls as India won by 160 runs.

title: South Africa returns to international cricket
summary: South Africa played its first ODI, against India at Eden Gardens in Kolkata, returning to international cricket after more than 21 years. India won by three wickets.

title: McCullum’s 158* launches the IPL
summary: Brendon McCullum made an unbeaten 158 off 73 balls for Kolkata Knight Riders against Royal Challengers Bangalore in the first IPL match.
